what_this_is: A lead to booking reconciliation executed over invented records, so the rules it follows can be replayed and checked. Nothing here describes any real business.

rules.text: A lead becomes a booking when the booking carries that lead id.
A follow-up or reminder call attaches to the lead it belongs to and never opens a new one.
Re-importing the same records changes no total, and a record that changed is reported as a conflict.
A booking with no key back to a lead stays unattributed and stays visible.
A booking entered by one brand and performed by another keeps both dimensions and counts once in the group total.

checks.question: Does a booking entered by one brand and performed by another count once in the group total?
checks.expected: the entry view and the performing view each sum to the group total
